source.source_name: YouTube Help — Advanced Mode analytics report exports
source.purpose: Check Studio Advanced Mode CSV export completeness and distinguish the 500-row export cap from Reporting API bulk access
source.cost_quota: public help article; no owned-channel API call
source.reliability_limits: A 500-row export is potentially truncated, not proof that more rows exist. Reporting API requires its own authorization and availability; this source is not proof of channel access.

learning.title: Studio Advanced Mode export has a 500-row completeness limit
learning.claim: YouTube Studio Advanced Mode exported reports contain at most 500 rows; a 500-row export must not be treated as complete when the underlying report could contain more rows, and YouTube Reporting API is the documented bulk alternative.
learning.decision: YOUTUBE_STUDIO_EXPORT_500_ROW_GATE: A Studio Advanced Mode export containing 500 data rows reaches the documented limit; label completeness UNKNOWN/POSSIBLY_TRUNCATED rather than COMPLETE. Do not assume the unexported rows exist or calculate full-channel totals by summing that potentially capped file. If complete row-level bulk data is needed, use the YouTube Reporting API only after authorization and report compatibility are verified. Keep this separate from the Reporting API header-only no-data and privacy-suppression gates.
learning.next_measurement: On the next authorized Studio export, count data rows, record report dimensions/time window, flag 500 as possibly truncated, and compare against a permitted Reporting API report or trustworthy channel totals when available. Until then real-channel completeness and ingestion are unverified.
fallback_history: Without Reporting API authorization, report the 500-row cap and leave full dataset completeness unknown; do not invent missing rows or infer totals.

research_evidence.youtube_video_note: Official YouTube Creators 2020 video transcript 03:27-03:33 says Studio UI shows 50 rows and export up to 500; current documentation independently confirms export limit.
